curation_notes: All original game titles retained. The existing Alan Wake Remastered mismatch remains explicitly flagged pending the owner decision.
399 original IDs returned released-game metadata; the remaining incorrect 1000xRESIST ID was corrected. Label correctness is a separate check.
Forza Horizon 4, Fall Guys and Rocket League remain useful recognizable answers despite delisting or unavailability for new purchases.
Layers of Fear app 391720 is the 2016 original; do not use reviews for the 2023 game.
Store edition/marketing renames on the same app ID do not require duplicate answers (Control, Northgard, GTA V and others).
The new games are catalog candidates, not 110 completed manually curated puzzles. Each still needs six authentic, progressive clues.
Planet of Lana II has verified total-review availability, but the research did not establish its English-review count.
Avoid unqualified DS2 guesses: both Dark Souls II and Death Stranding 2 are in the pool.
Do not equate original games with distinct remakes when choosing clues. Preserve sequel-specific identifying evidence.
